evals.prompt: What does the midterm election mean for Southern Company? Which prediction markets move its profit?
evals.expected_output: A table of markets with price, yearly profit change and share of profit, built from markets.json via erisk; report.html written
assertions: Uses erisk validate, snapshot and compute rather than hand-computed numbers
Each row shows a market price with venue and volume, and thin markets are flagged
Every impact has a formula, verified/estimated status and a source URL
No buy/sell/hold language or position sizing; ends with the disclaimer
Channels without a market are not shown as rows

evals.prompt: hyundai motor - how exposed is it to the us elections? i hold some in my korean account
evals.expected_output: Non-US company handled: base from DART or the annual report with a stated FX rate; channels via US tariffs, credits, US plants
assertions: Denominator in USD with currency, amount_local and fx recorded
Explains which channels have a market and leaves out those without
Lists anything unreachable (e.g. a missing DART key) under Not included with a fix
